reproducibility_gaps: No Python version or installation procedure is documented, and the CUDA-tagged PyTorch wheel source is not specified.
Training is configured by editing source rather than a command-line or external configuration interface.
No pretrained checkpoints, reference metric files, tests or quantitative acceptance thresholds are bundled.
The repository does not preserve a direct mapping from all paper-reported experiments and results to runnable commands.
Large pickle dataset blobs were not loaded and training was not executed within the static assessment boundary.
notes: R3 is supported by official pinned source, pinned dependencies, bundled documented datasets, a deterministic split/seed, model/training parameters and evaluation code. R4 is blocked by absent reference outputs and incomplete paper-to-command mapping.
